svg.title: Failure-label rates across operating conditions: All product types
svg.desc: All product types: 10000 records, 339 Machine failure labels, 348 records with any mode flag, 27 label/flag disagreements. Rates use the published Machine failure field. The released table supplies record identifiers rather than observation timestamps. Speed [1000, 1200) rpm; torque [0, 10) Nm is selected. The 100-row companion retains support and exact values. Source type: published-generated-records; DOI https://doi.org/10.24432/C5HS5C; license CC-BY-4.0; verified-input SHA-256 dc6630cd9b1f0f853922fad78a1b6436570d3f1ec863f1dd5c4340ac56bc8a8e.

g.text: All product types | 10000 records | 339 machine-failure labels
